display_name: Session A (Broker 22:00-06:00, Buy inside / Flat outside)

logic.summary: Long-only time-window model: hold a buy during broker server time 22:00-06:00 and stay flat outside the window.
logic.economic_rationale: Calendar/session drift: gold shows positive expected return in the overnight Asia session window; exposure is limited to that window.
known_assumptions: Hours are broker SERVER time, not UTC; DST shifts the effective UTC window.
Market-closed cooldown (retcode 10018) prevents order spam at rollover.
rejection_criteria: Edge vanishes when window start/end are shifted by +/-1h.
Negative Out-of-Sample expectancy after overnight spread and swap.
